china_race_dynamics.text:
The energy war has a new front: AI.

We cannot let China dominate this critical technology. America must lead

My work in Congress is about unleashing our oil, gas, and renewables to fuel the future and keep us #1.

Time to win this battle⚡ https://t.co/KfUhdVuZ2M

deepseek.reason: The speaker says America cannot let China dominate AI and must lead and win this battle.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly names China and calls for American leadership in the AI competition.
